title: Treasure Hunt on a Mysterious Island!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A one and a two! One and a two!
Warm-ups fully up warmed!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nothing better before a treasure hunt than
warming up! Go on, you,
get to stretching!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A strange place, an even stranger
Umamusume, and a treasure hunt...
I can't
wrap my head around what's happening.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Really though, are you even listening?
Hello? Hel-lo? Helloooo?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ring ring, ring ring. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for calling.
This is Golshi's Ask
Me Anything hotline.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is your problem one of continental scale?
Global scale? Or even
cosmic scale?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Customers calling with a question today
will receive our grand double
conundrum
prize! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, I'm offering cosmic solutions and
all you think to ask about
is your measly
little personal problem?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're hopeless. How's this? In the name
of goodwill, I'll answer you
that one for
free.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen up—
we crossed the wild trails of the
mountains beyond Tracen, escaped the
narrowest of caves, and made it through
perilous jungles to get here...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In other words... we're somewhere on
Earth.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh please,
no need to panic! I don't really
remember where, but it's
Earth, so we'll
make it back someday!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I need you to focus. You do remember why we're here, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A reminder then—there's a priceless treasure waiting for us. Something that'll make me the undisputable, most powerful Umamusume ever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We came all the way here to get it. And you're gonna help me find it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sooo,
let's start this treasure hunt! ♪ Cue
the fanfare! You better tell
me as soon as
you unearth the goods!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can grasp the situation,
I'm forced
into joining this treasure
hunt of hers...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several hours later...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! What's this old, beat-up canoe doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wowiiie! Check out those holes! A boat
like this'll leak for sure! I bet
it'd sink us
real fast!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And what do we have here... That's the
stuff! Nothing says treasure
like moldy
boots!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh,
that sweet fishy aroma... Like a tuna
troller of old... Really
takes me back to my
days fishing on the open seas...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what the heck am I doing?! No time
to wallow in nostalgic bliss!
Find that
treasure already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been worked up like this since we
got here. What exactly could
she be
searching for?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? What're you looking at me for?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I think I know. ☆ You must've fallen
head over heels for my
beauty. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I know it must be difficult... But you
mustn't stare.

That—would—be—naughty. ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know treasure? Obvs it'll be all
sparkly. Don't think. Feeeel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now I have even less of a clue...
I guess I'll
just start looking over
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk over to some palm trees and notice
a coconut that's fallen to
the ground.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For-ward! For-ward! Onward we go! ♪
Come on out, come on out,
tricky little
treasure! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa... WHOOOAAA!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's...
the super healing fruit of the
tropical realms! Are you
some kinda genius
or what?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yah-hooo! ♪ That's the treasure I've been
looking for! Careful now,
just lay it on the
ground!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was a long shot, but I guess
this is really what Gold Ship
wanted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I place the coconut on the ground as
instructed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...All right. Now retreat to safety.
What's
about to happen is far too
dangerous for a
mere mortal.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wataaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whack! Crack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She cracks open the rock-hard coconut with her bare hands! You need to be fearless and have tremendous strength to do that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hehe, split it right down the
middle.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now's about the time for a little
break. Go
ahead, take a seat,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With little else to do on this deserted beach, I accept my coconut half and sit down on some driftwood... To be continued
